title: Lateen theme options
description: Every key a site may write under `theme.options` in `mizzen.yml`. The theme never requires a block: an absent key keeps the shipped behaviour, and a value it cannot use is ignored or, where a unit says so, stops the build with the option's path. `test/options-schema.test.ts` validates every site in this repository with this schema and fails when a unit reads a key the schema does not list.

announcement.description: The dismissible bar above the header. It renders nothing without `text`.

id.description: The dismissal key, so two bars are remembered separately.

text.description: The message. The bar is absent without it.

href.description: Where the message links: `http`, `https`, `mailto`, or a root-relative path. Other schemes are dropped.

tone.description: How serious the message is. A non-`info` tone adds a visible label and icon.

brand.description: Brand overrides. Every value is optional; an absent one keeps the shipped token.

accent.description: The accent, links, focus ring, selection, and selected state, in light and dark.

neutral.description: A shared neutral tint or explicit canvas, surface and text colours per scheme.

radius.description: A multiplier of the shipped corner scale.

density.description: A multiplier of the spacing rhythm; `comfortable` is the shipped scale.

showpiece.description: The home showpiece look a preset carries.

motif.description: The seed text of the decorative motif.

detailsUrl.description: Where the details link points: a site path or an `https` URL. Missing or unsafe values show no link.

headingLinks.description: `true` adds a per-heading suggest-an-edit link; any other value, or no block, leaves them out.

favicon.description: The icon links, each a path from the site root.

feedback.description: Removed in 0.2.4: Lateen no longer renders a page feedback widget. The key is still accepted so an existing config validates, and it is ignored.

footer.description: The site footer lines and links.

links.description: Footer links with a title and a safe URL: `http`, `https`, `mailto`, or a root-relative path.

addCard.description: A closing card with a `label` and a `link`. A blank label or an unsafe link renders nothing.

glossary.description: The data collection and page that carry the glossary and its inline terms.

collection.description: The collection holding the terms; its fields are `term`, `definition`, and `aliases`.

page.description: The address of the page that carries `::glossary`, or one address per language.

limit.description: How many change events a record history shows.

installTabs.description: The package managers the install tabs offer.

managers.description: Up to eight managers, each with a `name` and a `command`. `{package}` in a command becomes the package name; entries without both are skipped.

logo.description: The header mark. A root-relative path gets the site base; an absolute URL is used as written.

siblings.description: Lists the current page's local sibling pages under its group in the sidebar.

network.description: The network chrome: project switcher and network footer.

search.description: Offers cross-project search. Set to false to search only this project while retaining network navigation.

position.description: Places the switcher in the header or above the network footer. Any other value stops the build.

providers.description: Each provider has a `title` and a `url`; `{markdown}`, `{json}`, `{url}`, and `{title}` are filled per page. Without the block the menu offers Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

preset.description: A shipped set of brand options, used as a starting point.

reportIssue.description: The report-an-issue link. `false` turns it off.

labels.description: Labels to request on the new issue.

template.description: The issue template name the forge adds to the new-issue URL.

titlePrefix.description: Text placed before the issue title.

url.description: A tracker template for hosts other than GitHub and GitLab; `{title}`, `{body}`, `{url}`, `{source}`, `{lang}`, and `{version}` are filled.

editor.description: A URL template that opens a block in a local editor. It must include `{path}`; `{line}` and `{column}` are optional. Only editor-handler schemes are accepted.

show.description: `false` leaves the notice out while the data stays on the page.

maxFiles.description: How many changed files the notice lists.

status.description: The site's own map from a data value to a status tone and label.

values.description: One entry per data value. An unmapped value still shows, as written, in the neutral tone.

tone.description: The status tone; `neutral` when absent or unknown.

label.description: The visible label, or one label per language.

description.description: The legend's explanation, or one per language.

contextPackUrl.description: A link that copies or opens the page's context pack; `{url}`, `{title}`, `{source}`, `{build}`, `{generated}`, and `{reviewed}` are filled.

suggestEditUrl.description: A link that opens the host's edit or new-issue form; the same placeholders are filled.

localizedText.description: One string shared by every language, or a map from language code to string.

fontFamily.description: One self-hosted family and its files.

family.description: The family name written in `@font-face` and first in the stack.

files.description: One entry per weight: `src` (a root-relative path), `weight`, and optionally `style`.

src.description: A root-relative path; a font from another origin is not allowed.

weight.description: A font weight such as 400 or "100 900".
